_doc: The player's district on their side of the front (src/core/district_rules.gd). A building opens when the player's lifetime souls reach `souls`; it adds `bonus_bp` to the idle rate of `currency`; a keeper (an owned heroine) of the side's faction (celestial for heaven, infernal for hell; the fallen count for both) doubles it.

levels._doc: A built building is level 1; gold raises it to max. Bonus at level L = bonus_bp * (L + 1) / 2 (x1 .. x3 at 5). Going from L to L + 1 costs gold_base * L * L * (10000 + cost_step_bp * building index) / 10000 gold.
